In this contribution, we discuss whether to capture the Rel-16 R1 and R4 feature lists as well as RAN2 UE capabilities in a TR like TS38.822 in Rel-15 In Rel-15, TS38.822 is used to capture the Rel-15 R1 and R4 feature lists as well as RAN2/Layer 2 features. Each of the feature lists are placed in different sections; R1 feature list is in Layer 1 features table, R2 features in Layer 2 features table and R4 feature list is in RF and RRM features table. For R1 and R4 feature list, other than capturing the features lists provided by RAN1 and RAN4 in the form of LSes into a TR, the tables also include the field name in 38.331 for the feature as well as the parents IE related to it if one exists as highlighted below. RAN2 has studied different aspects of Topology 2 during the Rel-19 study phase. The study outcome has been captured in the TR 38.369. As a general guideline, we think RAN2 shall focus on the study outcome captured in the TR. New options for the issues captured in the TR shall not be discussed unless it is justified. In addition, this contribution focuses on single UE reader, single service scenario... RAN2 sticks to the options captured in the TR 38.369. New options shall not be discussed unless it is fully justified.
